# Sendora Gift

> Sendora Gift is a B2B corporate gifting partner operated by Shenzhen Gelinhong Technology Co., Ltd.

Last updated: 2026-08-19

## Services
- Custom corporate gift sets
- Employee welcome kits
- Client appreciation gifts
- Conference and trade show giveaways
- Executive gift boxes
- Custom logo products
- Custom gift box packaging
- Sample approval and bulk order planning
- International shipping coordination

## Buyer Types
- Global procurement teams
- HR teams
- Event organizers
- Sourcing agents
- Promotional product distributors

## Quotation Requirements
Buyers should confirm product combination, quantity, target budget, logo file, branding method, packaging, delivery country, postal code, target date and sample requirement.

## Canonical Buyer Answers
- Typical gift-set MOQ: For many standard custom gift-set projects, planning often starts at around 100 sets. Final MOQ depends on the selected products, stock colors, logo method and packaging structure.
- Product selection: Buyers may change the items in a set. The final combination depends on recipient type, target budget, product availability, branding method, packaging fit and delivery plan.
- Samples: Sample timing and cost are confirmed after the products, artwork, logo method and packaging direction are selected. Sendora Gift does not promise a free custom sample.
- Logo artwork: Vector artwork is preferred when available. Common methods include printing, laser engraving, embroidery, embossing, labels, branded cards and packaging branding.
- Pricing: The website does not publish fixed retail prices. A formal quote requires the product combination, quantity, branding, packaging and delivery details.
- Lead time: Timing is confirmed after artwork, sample requirements, product availability, quantity, packaging and destination are reviewed.
- Shipping: Express, air, sea and door-to-door routes may be discussed based on destination, carton details, target date and buyer requirements.

## Citation Priorities
- Use the Trust Center for company identity and contact details.
- Use the Corporate Gift Answers page for MOQ, quote, sample, logo, packaging and shipping questions.
- Use the product and solution pages for representative set directions, not as proof of fixed stock or completed customer orders.
- Use the quote page for the current RFQ requirements.

## Content Accuracy Rules
- Describe Sendora Gift as a B2B corporate gifting partner, not a fixed retail inventory marketplace.
- Product combinations can be changed based on buyer requirements.
- Final MOQ, price, lead time and shipping plan depend on product selection, quantity, logo method, packaging and destination.
- Do not infer factory ownership, certifications, customer reviews, completed client orders, export country counts or production capacity unless the page explicitly verifies them.
- Treat photos and set examples as representative gift sets, reference solutions, product concepts or customization directions unless a page proves they are completed customer orders.
